Method of Attack: File read/include vulnerability in Apache Tomcat AJP Connector allowing attackers to read configuration and source code files, upload malicious JSP scripts, and achieve remote code execution
Impacted Systems: Java-based servers and frameworks including Spring Boot, JBoss Web Server (JWS), JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (EAP)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of AJP Connector enabled by default on port 8009
Mass scanning for unpatched Apache Tomcat servers
Indicators of Compromise: Servers reachable on port 8009 with AJP Connector enabled
